headline: Keep the garden view

body: The designer replaced a tall sofa with a low sofa to keep the garden visible from the doorway. An open end preserves the route to the terrace.

pitch: Keep the view open through the living room

body: The original stair landing blocked the hall. Moving the first step back opened the passage. The designer chose the Example Oak Handrail to continue the line around the turn.

headline: Make room for the table

body: The room was too narrow for chairs on both sides of the table. A built-in bench against the wall kept the central aisle open.

pitch: Making a narrow dining room work
